Looking for an opportunity where you can make an impact every day? Discover this exciting opportunity supporting the Air Force Modeling and Simulation Support Services (AFMS3\) program. Serco is proud to support the Air Force Modeling and Simulation Support Services (AFMS3\) contract. * **US citizenship is required.**
* **An active U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**

* Experience developing and supporting Learning Management Systems.
* Experience with web development and modern application architecture.
* To be proficient in PHP and Python development.

* A strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to create and maintain learning analytics, dashboards, and reporting solutions with IntelliBoard.
* Familiarity with deploying and operating applications in Cloud One environments.
* Strong understanding of MongoDB database design, development, and administration.
* Proficiency using version control tools such as Git or Bitbucket.
* Exposure to Agile methodologies and the software development lifecycle.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

DWELR is building a residential intelligence platform designed to make the rental housing market more transparent, accountable, and easier to navigate. Our platform brings together tenant\-submitted reports, verified residency information, public records, property data, landlord and property\-management information, and AI\-powered analysis to help people better understand rental properties and housing conditions.

We are seeking a **Full Stack Software Engineer** to help build, improve, and scale the technology behind DWELR. In this role, you will work across the front end, back end, database, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and third\-party integrations. You will help develop both the existing DWELR platform and future products, including our planned AI Powered residential intelligence and property\-risk analysis systems.

This is an early\-stage startup role with meaningful ownership. You will not be limited to maintaining one small part of a large application. You will help design features, make technical decisions, solve real product problems, and take functionality from initial concept through production deployment.

You will collaborate with DWELR’s leadership, product, design, data, AI, trust and safety, and operations teams to build secure and dependable experiences for renters, rental\-property owners and managers, housing professionals, government partners, and institutional customers.

**What You Will Work On**

Depending on company priorities and your areas of expertise, your work may include:

* Tenant reporting, review, and residency\-verification workflows.
* Rental\-property, landlord, property\-management company, and neighborhood profiles.
* Property search, filtering, maps, geolocation, and address\-matching systems.
* Landlord and property\-manager account claiming and verification.
* Review\-response, dispute, correction, and evidence\-submission workflows.
* Subscription, payment, billing, and account\-management features.
* Administrative tools for moderation, trust and safety, data quality, and customer support.
* Public\-record and municipal\-data integrations.
* Notifications, alerts, saved properties, and property\-monitoring tools.
* Dashboards for renters, property owners, government partners, and institutional customers.
* Data infrastructure supporting AI powered intelligence systems.
* AI\-assisted search, document analysis, evidence retrieval, summarization, and residential intelligence features.
* Internal systems that help DWELR review evidence, track data provenance, and maintain reliable property records.

**Responsibilities** 

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain full\-stack features across the DWELR platform.
* Develop responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces using modern JavaScript and TypeScript technologies.
* Build and maintain backend services, serverless functions, APIs, database procedures, and scheduled processes.
* Create secure RESTful APIs and integrations that allow DWELR’s applications and services to exchange information reliably.
* Design and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, relationships, indexes, queries, migrations, and data\-access policies.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, role\-based access, and account\-permission systems.
* Apply database\-level security controls, including row\-level security where appropriate.
* Integrate third\-party services such as Stripe, Google Maps, geocoding providers, email and notification services, analytics tools, and public\-data APIs.
* Build systems for importing, validating, normalizing, matching, and updating public\-record and property\-related data.
* Help develop the technical foundation for AI\-assisted features while ensuring that generated outputs remain connected to identifiable source evidence.
* Work closely with product and design contributors to translate product requirements and design files into production\-ready features.
* Write clean, reusable, well\-documented, and maintainable code.
* Create automated tests for critical user flows, APIs, database operations, and business logic.
* Participate in code reviews and help establish practical engineering standards.
* Monitor application performance, investigate errors, and improve reliability.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks involving page speed, APIs, database queries, background jobs, and external integrations.
* Support secure software\-development practices involving privacy, user\-generated content, sensitive documents, and account data.
* Maintain source control, branching, pull\-request, testing, and deployment workflows.
* Contribute to CI/CD processes that allow the team to test and release changes safely.
* Document technical decisions, system behavior, deployment procedures, and important dependencies.
* Help DWELR make sensible architecture decisions as the platform grows, without introducing unnecessary complexity.
* Communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, blockers, and implementation options clearly to both technical and nontechnical team members.

**Required Qualifications**

* Professional experience developing and maintaining full\-stack web applications.
* Strong proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience with a modern front\-end framework such as React.
* Experience building backend services, serverless functions, or application APIs.
* Strong understanding of RESTful API design and client\-server architecture.
* Practical experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
* Ability to write efficient SQL queries and understand database relationships, constraints, indexing, and migrations.
* Experience implementing authentication, authorization, user roles, and secure data\-access controls.
* Familiarity with Git\-based version control and collaborative pull\-request workflows.
* Experience testing, debugging, and deploying production applications.
* Understanding of web security fundamentals, including validation, access control, secure authentication, and protection of sensitive information.
* Ability to turn product requirements and design specifications into reliable working software.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technical issues independently.
* Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in an early\-stage, cross\-functional environment.
* Ability to take ownership of a feature through planning, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch improvement.

We value demonstrated ability and real\-world project experience. Candidates may qualify through professional employment, startup work, substantial independent projects, open\-source contributions, or another credible body of work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with any of the following would be beneficial but is not required:

* React, Next.js, or a comparable React\-based application framework.
* TypeScript across both front\-end and backend development.
* Supabase, including Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL, Storage, Edge Functions, and row\-level security.
* Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, or similar serverless and edge\-computing platforms.
* Stripe subscriptions, billing, checkout, customer portals, and webhook integrations.
* Google Maps Platform, address autocomplete, geocoding, map\-based search, or geospatial data.
* PostgreSQL extensions, full\-text search, vector search, or geospatial queries.
* Data ingestion, ETL pipelines, record matching, entity resolution, or public\-record integrations.
* AI or large\-language\-model integrations, including retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, structured outputs, evaluation, or source attribution.
* Building applications that process documents, evidence, user reports, or structured public data.
* Privacy\-conscious systems involving user\-generated content or sensitive information.
* Moderation, dispute\-resolution, audit\-log, case\-management, or trust\-and\-safety workflows.
* Search systems, recommendation systems, analytics platforms, or data\-heavy consumer products.
* Cloud monitoring, logging, alerting, and application observability.
* Automated testing frameworks and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
* Mobile application development or shared web/mobile architecture.
* Startup, PropTech, GovTech, CivicTech, marketplace, or SaaS experience.
* Housing, real estate, public\-data, or government\-information systems.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Full Stack Software Engineer at DWELR will:

* Reliably deliver complete, production\-ready features rather than isolated pieces of code.
* Build systems that are understandable and maintainable by future engineers.
* Make practical technical decisions appropriate for an early\-stage company.
* Improve platform security, performance, reliability, and data quality.
* Raise concerns early when a requested feature presents privacy, security, scalability, or implementation risks.
* Work effectively with changing priorities while maintaining engineering discipline.
* Understand the user problem behind a feature instead of implementing requirements mechanically.
* Help DWELR establish a strong technical foundation for future consumer, government, institutional, and AI\-powered products.

**Who This Role Is Best Suited For**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems
jobs.description:
About NeuroSpark

NeuroSpark builds and operates a high\-performance AI inference platform that helps enterprises run large language models faster, cheaper, and at scale. Inference infrastructure is the foundation the entire AI application layer runs on — every AI product ultimately depends on how fast, how reliably, and how affordably models can serve their users. Our vision is to make that layer so efficient that compute is never the reason a good AI product fails.

About the Role

Serving inference at scale is a scheduling problem. Requests arrive with wildly different shapes and latency expectations, GPUs are heterogeneous and expensive, and the difference between a platform that's fast and one that's economical usually comes down to how well work gets placed. That system is what you'll own.

You'll design and build the scheduling and routing layer of our platform: how requests get admitted, prioritized, batched, and placed across a heterogeneous multi\-cloud GPU fleet, under real multi\-tenant load and real latency commitments. This is core\-systems work with a clean slate — you'll be making the foundational architectural decisions, not maintaining someone else's, and the quality of those decisions will show up directly in our margins and our customers' latency numbers.

You'll work close to the metal and close to the math. Some days that means reasoning about queueing behavior and control loops on a whiteboard; other days it means profiling Go or Rust until the tail latency comes down. We're a small team, so you'll own systems end\-to\-end — design, implementation, rollout, and the production reality afterward.

Responsibilities

* **Own the scheduling and routing layer** — design and build request admission, prioritization, batching, and placement across a heterogeneous GPU fleet spanning multiple clouds and accelerator types
* **Engineer for latency and utilization at once** — drive down tail latency while driving up fleet utilization; these fight each other, and resolving that tension well is the job
* **Model the system, not just code it** — apply queueing theory, control theory, and load\-shedding principles to make the platform behave predictably under bursty, multi\-tenant traffic
* **Build multi\-tenant fairness and isolation** — ensure priority guarantees and SLO commitments hold when the fleet is saturated and customers are competing for the same capacity
* **Own it in production** — instrument, observe, and debug distributed behavior in a live system; carry your designs through rollout and real\-world load
* **Set the technical bar** — make foundational architecture decisions, write the design docs that anchor them, and raise the engineering standard of everyone around you

Qualifications

This is a senior individual\-contributor role. We're looking for someone who has built systems like this before and can operate independently from the first week.

* Substantial experience building and operating large\-scale distributed systems in production — you've owned something load\-bearing, not just contributed to it
* Track record of designing core systems from zero to one, and living with the consequences of your architectural decisions
* Hands\-on experience with scheduling, load balancing, request routing, or resource allocation systems
* Strong systems fundamentals — operating systems, networking, concurrency — and the ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior using queueing theory, control theory, or similar
* Fluency in a performance\-sensitive language (Go, Rust, or C\+\+), with the profiling and optimization instincts that come from actually chasing latency in production
* Comfort with GPU infrastructure and LLM inference fundamentals — batching, KV cache behavior, throughput/latency tradeoffs; deep expertise here is a plus, but strong distributed\-systems judgment matters more
* Clear technical writing — you can make a hard design decision legible to people who weren't in your head
* An AI\-native way of working — you use AI tools daily and have your own view of how they change how infrastructure gets built

Preferred Qualifications

* Mandarin proficiency is a plus

**Nice to have:** Kubernetes and multi\-cloud operations experience; open\-source contributions to inference, serving, or scheduling projects; experience operating GPU clusters at scale.

Why This Role

* Ownership of a core system at the foundation of the platform, with the architectural latitude that comes with building it first
* Meaningful equity — we expect the people who build the foundational systems to own a real piece of what they build
* A small, high\-caliber team where the distance between a good idea and it running in production is measured in days

How to Apply

Send your resume to with a short note: one distributed system you owned end\-to\-end — what it had to do, the key design decision you made, and how it held up in production.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this position is **$170,000 – $350,000 per year**. The range reflects the position across experience levels; actual base salary will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location, and may fall anywhere within the stated range.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity in the company, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage, and other benefits.

Additional Information

We are able to sponsor H\-1B and other work visas for qualified candidates.

NeuroSpark Inc is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Pay: $170,000\.00 \- $350,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Santa Clara, CA 95054

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**


We're hiring a **GTM Engineer** to build the machine behind our growth: the data pipeline, the outbound engine, and the source of truth the whole company runs on. This is a **build\-and\-own role**, not a support role.


We're an early\-stage, fast\-moving company building core infrastructure for the AI agent era — specifically the communication and identity layer that lets AI agents send, receive, and manage email programmatically. Backed by Y Combinator and a top\-tier seed round led by General Catalyst, we're inventing a market, not following one.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own the growth data layer end to end: instrument the funnel, enrich every signup, and build the dashboards the company treats as its source of truth
* Turn our best customers into ten more — through lookalike modeling, automated outbound, LinkedIn plays, and surfacing champions and buyers inside companies already using us
* Run experiments across the PLG engine (content, integrations, backlinks, paid) and double down on what moves signups
* Connect the stack through APIs, webhooks, and automation so data flows cleanly between product analytics, CRM, enrichment providers, and outbound tooling (e.g. PostHog and similar)
* Decide what tools we use and what gets cut — you own the stack
* Build AI\-powered internal tools; ship systems from prototype through rollout and adoption, then hold your ground — you built it, the team follows it

### **What We're Looking For**

**Required:**

* A technical foundation — CS, data science, or equivalent. You write real scripts in Python, TypeScript, and/or SQL, wire APIs together, and are comfortable using AI coding tools effectively
* You've seen a great growth motion up close, or you've been obsessively reverse\-engineering how the best PLG companies grow
* High agency in ambiguity: you call out what's broken, come with an opinion, and fix things without being asked
* Organized enough that the systems you build don't rot — clean data is a discipline, not a feature

**Nice to Have:**

* A genuine desire to help invent a market, not just run someone else's process
* Experience at or adjacent to developer\-tools, API\-first, or AI infrastructure companies

### **Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Salary:** $120,000 – $200,000 USD annually, depending on experience
* Early\-stage equity in a high\-conviction, fast\-growing startup
* **Visa sponsorship:** Not available

### **Location**


This role is **on\-site in San Francisco, CA**. We work together in person — no remote option for this position.
